description: Header file for rebase interactive functionality, defining structures and function prototypes related to editing and checking todo lists in a repository rebase operation.

methods.name: append_todo_help
methods.description: Generates help text for rebase todo commands.

methods.name: edit_todo_list
methods.description: Provides an interface to edit the list of rebase todo items.

methods.name: todo_list_check
methods.description: Checks the validity or consistency of a todo list.

methods.name: todo_list_check_against_backup
methods.description: Validates a todo list against a backup or previous version.
